# test/fixtures/brand/css-undefined-classes.txt - shrink-only baseline of the shipped-CSS gap
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# Library admin markup (lib/sigra/admin/**) and the generated admin shell
# (priv/templates/sigra.install/admin/**) emit sg-* classes that the one stylesheet the
# installer copies, priv/templates/sigra.install/admin/sigra_admin.css, does not define.
# Today 53 of them are defined only in the example application's app.css (a hand mirror
# that a generated host does not have) and 3 are defined nowhere (sg-branding-editor,
# sg-cluster--2 and sg-stack--4). A generated host renders those elements unstyled unless
# its own Tailwind/DaisyUI utilities happen to cover them. Moving all of that styling into
# the shipped file is a roughly 700-line shipped-byte change and a much larger golden diff,
# so this phase records the gap instead of hiding it.
#
# SHRINK-ONLY
# test/sigra/install/css_undefined_classes_test.exs computes the undefined set from the
# sources and compares it with the list below in both directions:
#   - a class that is undefined but not listed here FAILS: the gap may not grow. Define the
#     class in priv/templates/sigra.install/admin/sigra_admin.css; never add an entry here
#     to make the test pass.
#   - a class listed here that the shipped CSS now defines FAILS: remove the entry. The
#     baseline can only get shorter.
# One class per line, sorted, no duplicates. Lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# MEASURED
# 56 classes at creation (Phase 260 plan 07): 153 sg-* classes emitted by class="..." and
# class={...} attributes in the markup roots, 112 defined in the shipped sigra_admin.css.
# Of the 56, 53 are defined in the example app.css and 3 nowhere. The brand-mark and
# theme-switch entries (sg-brand-mark*, sg-theme-switch) are the ones the later brand-mark
# and explicit-theme CSS plan removes when it adds those rules to the shipped stylesheet.
sg-admin-body
sg-admin-content
sg-admin-crumbs
sg-admin-main
sg-admin-sidebar
sg-bottom-nav
